headline: French AI company Mistral released Mistral Large 4, a one-trillion-parameter model it says can beat some Chinese rivals, though its open weights are still three weeks away.
score_reason: Major launch from Europe's leading AI lab, but the performance claim is Mistral's own and benchmarks are pending.
importance_line: Developers and governments looking for a non-US, non-Chinese model get a new option, but the open release is not yet available and the performance claim is Mistral's own.
summary: TechCrunch reports that Mistral AI, the Paris-based AI developer, released Mistral Large 4, a multimodal model nicknamed Le Chonk with one trillion parameters (the adjustable settings a model learns in training), and Reuters carried the company's claim that it beats some Chinese models in certain areas. For now it is available only through a guarded public endpoint; Mistral says it will publish the open weights, the files that let others run the model, in about three weeks after safety testing, and that benchmark results are still pending.
notes: Reuters page blocked (HTTP 401); text read at TechCrunch. Reuters named for the headline claim only.
